description: This header file declares utility functions and constants for socket address creation, MAC address conversions, byte stream printing, and byte array manipulations used in a networking context, likely within a Wi-Fi mesh network project.

methods.name: printByteStream
methods.description: Prints the contents of a byte stream (vector of unsigned chars) for debugging purposes.

methods.name: createUnixSocketAddress
methods.description: Creates a UNIX socket address structure from a given path string.

methods.name: createUDPServerAddress
methods.description: Creates an IPv4 UDP server socket address structure for a specified port.

methods.name: createUDPClientAddress
methods.description: Creates an IPv4 UDP client socket address structure for a specified IP and port.

methods.name: macAddressToString
methods.description: Converts a 6-byte MAC address array into a human-readable string.

methods.name: areMacsEqual
methods.description: Compares two MAC addresses for equality.

methods.name: convert_u32_into_bytes
methods.description: Converts a 32-bit unsigned integer into a vector of bytes.

methods.name: convert_bytes_into_u32
methods.description: Converts a vector of bytes into a 32-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: remove_length_delimited_part
methods.description: Removes a length-delimited part from a byte buffer.
